best_echo_sets.commentary: Offers a 10% unconditional Healing% boost and an most importantly a 15% ATK% boost for the entire team, lasting 30 seconds whenever you heal yourself or any of your allies. This bonus can be triggered by character abilities and weapon effects, is easy to keep active 100% of the time and is a big help for all party members.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: Simple summon Echo that can be cast any time (ideally right before the wielder's Outro), granting 10% ATK to the team for 20s (sufficient for 2 other teammates' rotation times if cast right before Outro) as well as 10% Energy Regen to the wielder to help with Energy requirements.

best_weapons.commentary_details: The best overall weapon for all Rectifier damage dealers. While Buling is not a damage-oriented character being mostly a Support, she does want to optimize her damage ideally since none of her buffs scale off of a particular stat or condition. As Stringmaster is the best general option for Rectifier damage dealers, it is also the strongest option on Buling thanks to its huge universal damage buffs.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Increases the DMG Bonus by {0}. When dealing Resonance Skill DMG, increases ATK by {1}, stacking up to 2. This effect lasts for 5s. When the equipped Resonator is not on the field, increases their ATK by an additional {2}.

best_weapons.commentary_details: As another strong generalist option, Phrolova's Signature enables Buling to deal a good chunk of damage while not packing as much of a punch as Stringmaster, making it the second best option available for her.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: ATK is increased by {0}. Within 12s after dealing Echo Skill DMG, gain {1} Resonance Skill DMG Bonus and {1} Echo Skill DMG Amplification, and ignore {2} of the target's DEF when dealing damage.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Mostly an ATK and CRIT DMG stat-stick for Buling, who can barely stack its Basic Attack DMG-oriented effect, but it can still be used decently on her.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Increases ATK by {0}. Using Resonance Skill gives the equipped Resonator {0} Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 6s, stacking up to 3 times. When casting Outro Skill with 3 stacks, consume all stacks to give {1} DMG Bonus to the off-field Basic Attacks performed by the equipped Resonator, lasting for 27s.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Buling, who does not benefit from this weapon's Spectro Frazzle-oriented effects.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Increase ATK by {0}. Dealing DMG to targets with Spectro Frazzle grants the wielder {1} Basic Attack DMG Bonus and {1} Heavy Attack DMG Bonus, stacking up to 3 times for 6s. Casting Outro Skill Amplifies the Spectro Frazzle DMG on targets around the active Resonator by {2} for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Strongest permanently available option, which grants a lot of ATK and increased Energy Regen as well as some minor amounts of Basic Attack DMG to the wearer which Buling uses decently. One of the strongest options to increase Buling's Healing capabilities while simultaneously increasing her damage by a solid amount, this option can be considered even over above options in order to optimize Buling's Sustain capabilities.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Increases Energy Regen by {0}. When hitting a target with Basic Attacks, increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus by {1}, stacking up to {2} time(s). This effect lasts for {3}s and can be triggered 1 time(s) every 0.5s.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Fully F2P-accessible craftable weapon that capitalizes on Buling's ability to instantly apply Electro Flare on her enemies, which allows this weapon's ATK-increasing passive to be quickly stacked up to the maximum effect for a lot of ATK buffing in total. Still pales in comparison to any 5-stars due to a lack of solid Base ATK.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Dealing DMG to enemies with Negative Statuses increases the wielder's ATK by {0} for 10s. This effect can be triggered 1 time per second, stackable up to 4 times.

example_teams.team_notes: Only use Zhezhi with Carlotta/Cantarella with Phrolova. Danjin can work as a F2P replacement for Phrolova.

cons: Almost always worse than Verina/Shorekeeper as a generalist. For endgame-level accounts that already own the two stronger generalists, or Supports for specialized teams (different forms of Rover, Chisa, Lupa, Suisui, etc.), she will only ever find use in Matrix;

A lot of her general buffing potential is tied to Skill damage dealers and Electro Flare characters, which limits teams where she stands out, as well as her S6, which is not easily accessible in the short-term.
pros: Good generalist buffing reminiscent of already known viable Supports like Verina and Baizhi, featuring her own constant off-field healing while being able to inflict Electro Flare on enemies (very relevant in Hsin teams, her current best use case);
Needs close to no investment whatsoever to perform - at S2+, she can be used on her Trial build in Endstate Matrix and will need literally no investment at all to perform there;
As a 4-star character, she is quite easy to access permanently alongside Sequence nodes;
Basically always better than Baizhi. A 4-star that has a solid use case for once!

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Buling is a 4-star Electro Rectifier Support character with abilities ranging from healing, to Electro Flare application, to general and specialized buffs oriented towards Skill damage dealers. Specialized in buffing Skill damage Main DPS characters like Hsin, Carlotta and Phrolova, while retaining more generically applicable buffs for account-wide use, Buling is a character with easy gameplay yet pretty viable buffs that are definitely worth checking out.

sections.heading: Key Mechanics & Buffs
paragraphs: Buling's kit allows her to provide the team with the following array of buffs & utilities when fully executing her rotation:
10% team-wide Skill DMG Bonus for 24s after casting her Enhanced Ultimate and any character's Intro, which can go up to 25% when a Second Intro is cast (goes up to 50% at S6);
15% team-wide General DMG Amplification for 30s when casting her Outro (doesn't expire when swapping);
25% team-wide ATK for 20s with the Rejuvenating Glow Echo set and Fallacy of No Return (which she should always run in her current teams);
Healing on her Intro, some of her Heavy Attacks and her Outro (constant off-field healing to the active character);

Periodic Electro Flare application via her Intro and enhanced Ultimate (turns into Electro Rage at 10 stacks or above - deals periodic damage to afflicted enemies, possibly enhanced if Electro Rage is also applied up to 10 stacks);
Small amounts of enemy grouping via her Skill.

As can be seen above, a lot of her kit revolves around building up to an Enhanced Ultimate, and that is indeed the focus of her kit; obtained by activating 2 of her unique set of Heavy Attacks, Buling's gameplay revolves around generating and consuming at least 4 Trigrams in order to access her Enhanced Ultimate to apply the majority of her buffs to then end her rotation.

sections.heading: Moveset & Rotation
paragraphs: Aside from some specific Heavy Attacks, Buling will always use almost all of her moveset to execute her rotations so all of her available moves are worth using. They all revolve around accomplishing the goal of generating enough Trigrams to access her enhanced Ultimate.

Buling possesses several ways to generate Trigrams, including her Basic 2, Basic 4, Skill and Mid-Air Attack. We make use of all of these features in her rotation. She can generate Thunder Trigrams and Mountain Trigrams, the former being acquired via her Basic 4, Skill and Mid-Air Attack while the latter is only acquired via her Basic 2. This causes an imbalance of Trigrams and she will tend to generate many more Thunder than Mountain Trigrams. Different Heavy Attacks exist depending on the combinations of Trigrams, but in practice we will use the "Mountain over Thunder" and "Twin Thunders" attacks to execute our rotations (since they can be generated in this order the quickest).

To do so, we generate a Mountain and Thunder Trigram by executing a Basic Attack 2 into Basic Attack 4 (without an Intro available, to generate extra Concerto Energy) or Mid-Air Attack (with an Intro available, since her Intro gives the Concerto needed for this), then we can use her Skill which directly combos into her Basic 4 for 2 quick extra Thunder Trigrams. Since we're holding the max of 4 Trigrams, we can then cast her Heavy Attacks to access our Enhanced Ultimate and finish her rotation.
Buling's Dodge Counter also allows her to directly transition into her Basic Attack 3, which means it's perfectly usable to follow with the rest of your rotation if necessary.

sections.heading: Meta Position & Conclusion
paragraphs: Buling's meta position has changed a lot since her initial release. Most notably, the release of Hsin and Endstate Matrix have allowed her to find a lot more use on many accounts. She is generally always better than Baizhi, possesses 2 Vigor, and has a brand new Electro Flare and Skill Damage team synergy in the form of Hsin. This allows her to find use on the majority of the accounts in the game.

Indeed, she almost does not need any investment, as her Trial build does the job completely fine for Endstate Matrix at S2+ (for Energy Regen purposes). At S0, some uninvested Rejuvenating Glow echoes with enough Energy Regen to scrape by, make her very easily usable with minimal investment as well. She is optimizable for a bit more damage if you really want to, and her S6 is a big increase to her relevancy in teams like Phrolova and Carlotta, as it allows her to provide bigger Skill damage buffs (where she'd otherwise just be outclassed by Verina significantly, Buling matches her with her S6).

In conclusion, Buling is a decent F2P-friendly generalist Support. For budget Electro Flare/Skill damage teams, or just as a better generalist than Baizhi in Endstate Matrix, she is very likely to find a use case somewhere in your Matrix runs, even though it's unlikely you use her in other places unless you're a beginner. As a 4-star Support though, she gets the job done quite well, so consider giving her a go for your next Matrix run if you haven't already.

synergies.commentary: Buling's best DPS characters to buff as they are Main Skill DMG-oriented DPS. Thanks to Buling's Outro, Echo Set and passive (enhanced via S6), she is capable of providing them with a wide array of ATK, DMG Amplification and Skill DMG Bonus buffs, which makes her suited as a solid Support choice for those teams, particularly if her S6 is unlocked. Hsin in particular is her best choice thanks to her modern damage numbers and ability to apply Electro Flare for Hsin to benefit from.
